measured: CI gate runs 44834908813 and 44836476025 on 2026-11-20 (ubuntu-latest), each on podman 5.7.0 rootless, cgroup v2, and docker 29.4.2 rootful, cgroup v2: four runs, the same answer on all four unless a check says otherwise

gosec.why: Scans have no network, so gosec cannot load the packages that import modules not in this repository; it names them and reports the rest (ADR 0040). Findings measured 2026-11-21 with native gosec 2.30.0 (Go 1.27.4) run as the sandbox runs it: non-root, no network, writable module cache, nothing downloaded. Findings gosec makes only with the modules present (native run with them downloaded) are under notMetYet. Gap measured in gosec-offline-gap-measurement-2026-11-21.md (project files). Unstable: gosec 2.30.0's taint rules (G7xx) reported 4, 4, 3 and 1 of these on four identical CI runs; 20 local runs of the same version on the same commit, also without module downloads, gave all 4 every time. Cause not found yet: an M2 known gap

trivy.why: trivy's advisory data is downloaded at run time (--update), so new advisories can add findings; the measured ones must stay
